params.prompt: A young person seen from behind at the far left edge of a long empty concrete corridor at dawn, walking away from camera toward a distant cool bright opening, calm and resolved. The right two-thirds of the frame is bare wall and soft grey-blue dawn light with nothing in it. A mood of a decision already made and written down. Vertical cinematic editorial photograph, shot on 35mm, shallow depth of field, moody dark graphite base tones with electric blue and a distinct mint-green accent light. Gen Z energy, real person, natural skin, candid and unposed, premium fashion-campaign quality. CRITICAL COMPOSITION RULE: the human subject must be pushed fully into the far LEFT edge of the frame, occupying at most the left third. The entire right two-thirds and the whole center of the frame must be clean, dark, uncluttered empty negative space with no subject and no busy detail. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no watermarks, no logos, no brand marks, no screens, no phone visible in frame.
